guards: Explicit approval must bind this corpus, prompts, models, ceiling and fresh expiry.
Every editor and evaluator call must pass existing authoritative native accounting admission. No tracking-only or direct unreserved calls.
Stop on unknown provider outcome, unsettled charge, exhausted budget or insufficient account/provider capacity; preserve all historical holds.
Full evidence and all three blinded drafts must fit the capped evaluator input; otherwise stop without truncating and revise the plan.
Do not rerun settled generations or silently retry malformed responses.
No finalist, transfer or repair calls are included in this approval.
nextStage: If promising, prepare bounded reserved-transfer and paired full-V3 baseline/finalist runs with unchanged verifier/repair; seek applicable approval before paid execution.

acceptance.semanticDecision: Meaningful supported understanding improvement with source-specific explanations; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved, never auto-pass.
acceptance.efficiencyMeasurement: Per-case and aggregate actual end-to-end model cost and generation duration, including verification and every repair. Evaluator cost separately reported as evaluation overhead. Tiny samples do not establish p95 or statistical superiority.
